title: AeroElast validation matrix row
description: One row of the validation matrix, at the granularity of the current '(3 cases)' Markdown rows: a coherent group of parametrisations whose exact collected node ids are listed in 'tests'. A row carries ONE own result and ONE OR MORE comparisons, because a single test routinely measures against several independent references at once, each with its own tolerance and margin. docs/validation/rows/<group>.yaml is the store; docs/validation-matrix.md sections 3-8 are generated from it. Cross-file rules (group resolution, node reconciliation, citation resolution, tolerated absence of .sources/) are enforced by tools/validation_matrix.py 'check'.

title.description: Human-facing row label, as the Markdown prints it today, including the '...[dist SS]' continuations.

items.description: Exact collected node id, verbatim from pytest --collect-only.

tests.description: Empty only for out-of-band evidence (evidence: out_of_band).

evidence.description: out_of_band marks a row with a published reference and no live test, e.g. section 10.1.

node.description: Which node, mode or station the value belongs to.

result.description: Our own measured value, optional: only meaningful when the test produces one. Each comparison says what this same result was compared against.

comparisons.description: 'My result versus several references', one entry per independent reference.

flags.description: Test-level human judgements only, ids from docs/validation/flags.yaml. Derived flags (near, gt5) are computed per comparison and rejected by check.

label.description: Which part of the test this comparison covers: 'modes 1-5', 'the CCX leg', 'the analytical leg', 'N=16 cell'. It is what tells two references of one test apart.

asserted.description: Whether an assertion consumes this comparison. Orthogonal to measured.status: asserted with status not_printed is the 'asserts without printing a residual' case; not asserted with status n/a is the 'printed, never asserted' case that requires the info_only flag.

expected.description: Reference-side value, when the comparison has a single one. A number when the reference side is one number, text when it is not (a cell list, a mode table), null when it does not have one. The stored value is normalised, so a numeric expectation is queryable as a number and stays symmetric with measured.raw.

kind.description: self means the comparison is against another of our own models, which CONTRIBUTING rule 3 allows as a restrictive assertion. There is deliberately no 'schema' kind: a row with no independent reference is a software test and belongs out of scope, not in this store.

label.description: Verbatim cell, formula or code id, e.g. 'Table 12, MITC4+ N=16: 0.9978' or 'CCX 2.23, S4'.

citation.description: Required when kind == paper: key into docs/validation/references.yaml.

also_asserts.description: A further reference the same comparison reaches indirectly without asserting it, e.g. the PAPER_REFS 3D value printed for information only.

value.description: Null for sign, exact and subset.

source.description: Where the code states it, e.g. 'tol=0.01 per case in the _TWISTED_BEAM_CASES loop'.

justification.description: Required when the tolerance exceeds the 5% suite rule (CONTRIBUTING test rule 1); enforced for rtol and rel_err.

status.description: measured means a usable residual was obtained; not_printed means the test asserts without printing one; n/a means the comparison is not a validation result.

run.description: Revision the numbers were measured at.

margin_pct.description: Percent. The number section 13 sorts and flags on. Required iff status == measured.

text.description: Verbatim residual for the paper table, e.g. '0.9972 (0.06%)'.

digest.description: Digest of this comparison's printed evidence. The detector: any change in the printed digits changes it, so `regression` needs no tolerance to notice a movement. The numeric fields beside it are what measure the change once the digest has said which comparison moved.
